name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled static virtual hosts, including TLS certificates, security headers, compression, logging, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, Fedora-compatible PID and logging settings, and related SELinux considerations.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application from Git with Python, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, application dependencies, environment configuration, database setup, and a systemd service on port 8000.
